title: Ship a breaking release
description: Before a release that breaks the CLI's flags, the release check counts the recipes and scripts it would break. The founder decides every time.

question.text: Is this breaking release safe to ship?

scale.meaning: The share of known recipes that still run after the change

note: A one way door: no line is drawn and no criterion change is ever proposed. The ledger still records each call so the check's sensitivity can be measured.
